nodes.question: What are the social impacts associated with geological processes mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Geological processes are considered destructive, causing significant social impacts, economic losses, and negative effects on ecosystems.
nodes.paragraph: 2019; Pollock and Wartman 2020). Within geological processes, this is considered the most destructive (Su rez 1998) and responsible for social impacts, significant economic losses and negative effects on ecosystems (Perera et al. 2018). There are large records of human losses worldwide, such as the case of the Hima- layas, which recorded around 2000 landslides that caused the death of 5000 people during 2013. Other examples include in the USA where fatalities from this cause vary between 25 and 50 per year and the economic losses reach USD 2 billion (Schuster and Fleming 1986; Kjekstad and Highland 2009). In Ecuador between the years 1970 and 2019, 1,642 deaths were reported and the damage caused an economic impact of more than USD 900 mil- lion (Bravo-L pez et al. 2022). The most recent in the Andean region and simultaneously with the highest number of victims in the history of Ecuador, was the one that occurred in Alaus in March 2023 (Mac as et al. 2024).
